summary: plan toolchain-core-skill-replay-portability-and-evaluation-seed; schema jimuyun.tc-d1.implementation-contract.v1, self-hosted; global authorization empty; S0 RMAP-S0 establishes repository validator capability and detached probes, requirements TC-D1-002/003/004/010/012/013; package validation uses scripts/sc/skill_package_replay.py with capability config; detached negative must fail and positive pass; S1 RMAP-S1 preserves historical 8-01 bytes and binds historical validator, evidence, and current wrapper replay; S1 probes require expected compatibility failure/pass outcomes; S2 RMAP-S2 defines non-authorizing evaluation seeds and stable replay matrix, requirements TC-D1-006/007/008/010/012/013; matrix cases require positive, negative, historical_compatibility, dirty_baseline, knowledge_read_set, closed_policy exactly once; matrix results require case/category/surface/status/observation/evidence; S3 RMAP-S3 integrates vdd and acceptance consumers, downstream replay, and terminal closure; lifecycle states implementation-authorized then implementation-complete, neither implies acceptance/release/archive; manual disposition authorizes implementation based on deterministic round-3 repair evidence; evaluation native evidence minimum 1 with path+sha256 bindings and three repair-closure paths; backend has no hidden state/provider scheduling/subprocess ownership; forbidden changes include historical plan trees, PhaseA, runtime, logs, _bmad, bmad/gds skills; recovery preserves receipts and failed candidates, disables new callers on failure; terminal replay must compare stdout JSON exactly to receipt.
